text: What is your feeling weather? You can choose any feeling, or not sure.
We did it together! You can play again or choose all done.
Something else
You would like something else. Tell or show your grown-up what you need. Your choice matters.
You chose Happy. Does this feeling seem little, medium, or big? Not sure is okay too.
You chose Happy. What would you like right now? Every choice is okay.
Share my good news
You would like to share your good news. Tell or show your grown-up!
Do a happy dance
You would like a happy dance. Invite your grown-up to dance with you!
Invite someone to play
You would like to play together. Ask someone if they would like to join you!
Draw a happy picture
You would like to draw a happy picture. Ask your grown-up for some paper and crayons!
You chose Sad. Does this feeling seem little, medium, or big? Not sure is okay too.
You chose Sad. What would you like right now? Every choice is okay.
Sit with my grown-up
You would like your grown-up to sit with you. You can ask them to stay close.
Cuddle my soft toy
You would like to cuddle your soft toy. Your grown-up can help you find it.
Ask for a hug
You would like to ask for a hug. Hugs are a choice for both people.
Read a cozy story
You would like a cozy story. Choose a book to read with your grown-up.
You chose Mad. Does this feeling seem little, medium, or big? Not sure is okay too.
You chose Mad. What would you like right now? Every choice is okay.
Squeeze a soft toy
You would like to gently squeeze a soft toy. Ask your grown-up to find one with you.
Take a quiet pause
You would like a quiet pause. Let your grown-up know you would like a little space.
Tell a grown-up
You would like to tell a grown-up what happened. You can use words, signs, or pointing.
Try a gentle stretch
You would like a gentle stretch. Try a comfortable little stretch with your grown-up.
You chose Worried. Does this feeling seem little, medium, or big? Not sure is okay too.
You chose Worried. What would you like right now? Every choice is okay.
Hold my grown-up's hand
You would like to hold your grown-up's hand. You can ask them.
Ask what happens next
You would like to know what happens next. Ask your grown-up to tell or show you.
Stay near my grown-up
You would like to stay near your grown-up. Tell or show them you want to be close.
Bring my comfort toy
You would like to bring your comfort toy. Ask your grown-up to help you find it.
You chose Calm. Does this feeling seem little, medium, or big? Not sure is okay too.
You chose Calm. What would you like right now? Every choice is okay.
Keep playing quietly
You would like to keep playing quietly. Choose something you enjoy.
Listen to a gentle song
You would like a gentle song. Ask your grown-up to sing or play one with you.
Look at a picture book
You would like to look at a picture book. You can enjoy it with your grown-up.
Enjoy a quiet moment
You would like a quiet moment. You and your grown-up can settle somewhere comfortable.
You chose Not sure. Does this feeling seem little, medium, or big? Not sure is okay too.
It is okay not to know yet. What would you like right now?
Name feelings together
You would like to name feelings together. Your grown-up can help you find words.
Point to how I feel
You would like to point to how you feel. You can point to a face or a feeling picture.
Sit and think together
You would like to sit and think together. There is no hurry to choose a feeling.
Choose a feeling later
You would like to choose later. It is okay not to know how you feel yet.
